learning_objective: The learner can define foundation models and describe their core characteristics, including pre-training on large datasets and adaptability to downstream tasks.

common_misconceptions.description: Believing foundation models are immediately ready for specific applications without any adaptation or fine-tuning.
Assuming training a foundation model is a simple process rather than an incredibly complex and costly one.
Thinking you must know how to develop a foundation model from scratch to be able to use it effectively.
